title: adiantum incisum subsp. indicum
intro: Adiantum incisum subsp. indicum, commonly known as the Indian maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Pteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Adiantum incisum subsp. indicum include its potential anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce stress, improve respiratory health, and boost the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as a demulcent, expectorant, and emollient, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
